scope: Local scanner component with downloaded official signatures. No Azure or full application evaluation.
observations: FreshClam verified main.cvd version 63, daily.cvd version 28176 and bytecode.cvd version 339. SHA-256 digests are retained with scan outputs.
Four sequential actual-engine checks returned the expected clean/detected decisions.
Two concurrent scans on the same 2-vCPU/4-GiB container produced one clean result and one unresolved ClamAV timeout.
Per-request clamscan reloads signature data. A persistent bounded engine needs testing before claiming the planned concurrency target.
reproductionLimitations: Vendor databases are retained privately in the operator workspace, not included in Git. A later fresh download can differ.
YARA coverage is a harmless original pilot marker, not a production rule corpus.
The concurrent diagnostic used two ThreadPoolExecutor calls to process_document with distinct synthetic TXT payloads; it did not exercise HTTP ingress.
